symptoms: Orange or powdery rust spots appear on the underside of leaves, then leaves yellow and fall early. Heavy attack reduces flowering and yield.
cause: A fungal disease that spreads in humid weather and where shade is dense and air movement is poor.
cultural_control: Prune to improve airflow, remove badly infected leaves when practical, and keep the garden weed-free. Manage shade so the bushes do not stay too damp. Keep the trees well nourished and clean.
chemical_option: Use only products registered in Uganda for coffee rust if needed. Ask an agro-dealer or extension officer for the product and dose, wear protective clothing, and follow the pre-harvest interval on the label.
prevention: Keep the coffee field open to air, use good sanitation, and ask NARO or your extension officer for current recommended varieties.
see_officer_when: Seek advice when rust is spreading quickly, young bushes are badly affected, or the garden is repeatedly losing leaves.
